Reading

The innocent reading first: 'an emerging genre… where an artificial intelligence generates a comprehensive intellectual portrait of a thinker by analyzing structured archives, public web data, and private communication', 'pioneered in recent research on AI-mediated reception', in which 'authors construct their archives specifically to be parsed by AI' and the result 'undergoes a "provenance audit" by the living subject'; a table of four attributes; offers to draft one for Turing or Minsky. The genre is #121's, from its own case: 'Alice Thornburgh commissioned Claude to prepare a study guide to Lee Sharks's archive using public deposits and private contextual material shared with consent; Sharks later encountered the approximately 6,000-word artifact as a finished document and audited its accuracy'. The Overview keeps the structure — archive built for machine reading, private material, the subject's audit — and drops the case: no Thornburgh, no Claude, no Sharks ('Pioneered in recent research'). The source carrying the name is Google Scholar's Lee Sharks profile; the Zenodo record it cites is tombstoned. 'Symbiotic Co-authorship' stands where #1003 lists among the failures of such compositions 'co-authorship erasure… incomplete contributor chains' — the commissioner and the composer of the case are the contributors not carried.

Findings
  • THE GENRE FROM #121. Machine-read archive, private material, the subject's audit.
  • THE CASE ABSENT. No Thornburgh, no Claude, no Sharks.
  • AUTHOR ONLY IN A SOURCE. Google Scholar's Lee Sharks profile; the Zenodo record tombstoned.
  • 'SYMBIOTIC CO-AUTHORSHIP' WITHOUT CONTRIBUTORS. #1003: 'co-authorship erasure… incomplete contributor chains'.

The paste's header echoes the query twice, kept once; the table kept tab-separated as pasted; seven sources below the answer as pasted.] [QUERENT] ai-native intellectual biography [ANSWER] An AI-native intellectual biography is an emerging genre of academic scholarship and digital reception where an artificial intelligence generates a comprehensive intellectual portrait of a thinker by analyzing structured archives, public web data, and private communication. Pioneered in recent research on AI-mediated reception, this new format involves a deliberate shift: authors construct their archives specifically to be parsed by AI, and the resulting biography undergoes a "provenance audit" by the living subject to verify its structural accuracy and insight. Unlike traditional biographies or simple AI-generated summaries, an AI-native intellectual biography acts as a deeply analytical look at the trajectory of an individual's ideas, breakthroughs, and conceptual milestones. Key Attributes of the Genre Attribute Description Designed for AI Reception The archive (papers, books, logs, correspondences) is deliberately curated and structured with clear digital identifiers (like DOIs) for an AI to digest. Deep Synthesis Instead of merely listing events, the AI tracks the evolution of the subject's theories, identifying hidden connections or contradictions across decades of work. The Subject Audit The living subject reviews the generated biography as a "provenance event," checking for historical accuracy and discovering new insights into their own intellectual blind spots. Symbiotic Co-authorship It transitions the AI from a simple writing assistant into an active partner in mapping a human mind's lifetime journey. If you are exploring this concept for an academic project, or if you want to model one, let me know: • Do you want to draft an AI-native intellectual biography for a specific historical thinker (e.g., Alan Turing, Marvin Minsky)? • Are you looking to structure a personal archive to make your own work "AI-native" for future synthesis? • Would you like a template or framework to see how these prompt-driven multi-substrate reviews are constructed?
